SELECT c.name AS client_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'

SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary 
FROM companyx.employees e 
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id 
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, COUNT(p.id) AS project_count
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id
WHERE p.status = 'in_progress'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY project_count DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
(no SQL)

SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM companyx.departments d
JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count
FROM companyx.departments d
JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.name

SELECT e.name, e.email, e.position, d.name AS dept_name
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.hire_date) = 2022
ORDER BY e.hire_date ASC

SELECT e.position, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count
FROM companyx.employees e
GROUP BY e.position
ORDER BY employee_count DESC
SELECT c.name, c.industry, c.region FROM companyx.clients c WHERE c.company_size = 'enterprise'
SELECT registered_at FROM companyx.clients WHERE name = 'Client-AC'
(no SQL)

SELECT p.name
FROM companyx.products p
WHERE p.status = 'beta'

SELECT p.name, p.price_monthly
FROM companyx.products p
ORDER BY p.price_monthly DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT contract_type, COUNT(*) AS contract_count
FROM companyx.contracts
GROUP BY contract_type

SELECT c.name AS client_name, ct.amount AS contract_amount
FROM companyx.contracts ct
JOIN companyx.clients c ON ct.client_id = c.id
WHERE ct.status = 'cancelled'
ORDER BY ct.amount DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.projects WHERE status = 'in_progress'

SELECT p.name, p.budget
FROM companyx.projects p
WHERE p.budget >= 10000

SELECT p.category, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE s.quarter = '2026-Q2'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sales, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.sales
JOIN companyx.products ON companyx.sales.product_id = companyx.products.id
WHERE companyx.products.category = 'consulting'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, s.sale_date, s.amount
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' AND CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE assignee_id = (SELECT id FROM companyx.employees WHERE name = '임우진')

SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS client_name
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
WHERE p.name = 'SSL 인증서'

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600) AS avg_resolution_time_hours
FROM companyx.support_tickets
WHERE status = 'resolved'

SELECT e.name AS employee_name, e.position, d.name AS department_name
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE e.position = 'Manager'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, s.amount AS sales_amount, s.sale_date
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.sales s ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE p.name = 'Product-D3'
ORDER BY s.amount DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
